summary.text: Helmut Love is the Republican candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 57 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Stacey Evans (D).
A business consultant with a background in healthcare technology, he says his campaign centers on affordable living, safe neighborhoods and using AI for public services.

paragraphs.text: Helmut Love was born in El Paso, Texas, graduated from James E. Taylor High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from Texas A&M University in 1998 and a graduate degree from Northwestern University's Kellogg School of Management in 2009.
He graduated from Harvest Christian University in 2024.

His career experience includes consulting, 10 years at General Electric and five at McKesson, and he has been affiliated with the Fulton County Republicans, the Log Cabin Republicans, and The Gayly Impact nonprofit.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Love said he began as a biomedical engineer and later held leadership roles at major technology and healthcare companies, and that he currently consults with businesses on AI and strategy.
He described his campaign as centered on affordable living and smart taxes, safe neighborhoods, support for businesses and entrepreneurs, education, and transportation.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
